Paul applies it to unintelligible prayer where the mind is 'unfruitful' (1 Cor 14:14) and to 'the unfruitful works of darkness' (Eph 5:11). Spanish 'sin fruto' and French 'sans fruit' mirror the Greek morphology precisely — literally 'without fruit.'"
